title: What If Earth Stopped Spinning?

scenes.text: What if Earth stopped spinning? Suddenly, you would not feel the stop. You'd feel the speed.
At the equator the ground moves at about one thousand six hundred kilometres an hour. Stop the ground, and everything on it keeps going.
Air, oceans, buildings, you. The winds alone would be faster than any hurricane ever recorded.
Say it slowed gently instead. A day would last a year: six months of sunlight, six months of night.
The spin also bulges the oceans at the equator. Without it, water would drain towards the poles.
Leaving one giant continent around the middle of the planet, and two frozen oceans at the top and bottom.

description:
What if Earth stopped spinning?
Suddenly: everything keeps moving at 1,600 km/h. Slowly: a year-long day and oceans that migrate to the poles, leaving one continent around the equator.
What should we run through next?
first_comment: Sudden stop or slow stop: which one scares you more? What should we run through next?
